title: Shifting TV Purchase Journey
subTitle: Executive Strategy
scriptEn: Today, I’d like to cover three key areas of our 2027 LG TV strategy.First, we’ll look at how consumer expectations are evolving in the AI era and how LG AI TV is creating differentiated value to meet those changing needs.Next, we’ll explore how LG AI TV is evolving beyond conventional AI TVs into a Trusted Life Agent that understands users and proactively assists them.Finally, we’ll highlight how innovations across OLED evo and Micro RGB evo, together with our expanded Mini LED portfolio, will help LG and our partners capture new growth opportunities across the market.

title: 567
subTitle: Animated Slide (7 effects)
scriptEn: Let us begin by looking at how consumer expectations for TV are changing.To understand this shift, we first need to examine how the values consumers prioritize and the criteria they use to choose a TV are evolving.In 2025, specifications have been at the center of the TV purchase journey.Consumers asked questions such as, "What is the difference between 60Hz and 120Hz?" "Does it support Dolby Vision?" and "Can I use HDMI 2.1?" Their focus was primarily on what technologies and features a TV included.In other words, consumers typically distinguished products by their hardware specifications and supported formats.

title: 567
subTitle: Animated Slide (22 effects)
scriptEn: But in 2026, the direction of consumer questions began to change.Consumers are now looking beyond basic TV specifications and asking, "Why does AI Upscaling matter?" and "Which AI Processor creates a better TV experience?"This signals a shift in consumer interest from whether a feature is simply available to how AI meaningfully improves the actual TV experience.

title: 567
subTitle: Animated Slide (5 effects)
scriptEn: This change is also visible in real-world searches and consumer conversations.On Google Trends, the average search interest for AI TV increased from 26 to 40, surpassing that of the search term OLED TV.At the same time, 588 AI TV-related conversations were identified on Reddit from January through July 2026. This represents a 71% increase from the 344 conversations recorded across all of 2025.It is also worth noting LG's strong presence in AI TV-related brand searches.AI TV has become an important purchase consideration that consumers actively search for, compare and discuss.

title: 567
subTitle: Animated Slide (10 effects)
scriptEn: So, which aspects of AI TV are attracting consumers' attention?Of all the AI TV conversations on Reddit that we showed earlier, 54% focused on AI-powered performance improvements, including AI Picture Quality, AI Upscaling and AI Sound.Most notably, actual LG TV users shared positive feedback that AI Sound Pro noticeably improves sound from the TV speakers and that LG TVs deliver clear picture quality even in fast-moving game scenes.This shows that consumers already recognize the value of AI-enhanced TV performance, and that LG AI delivers specific, tangible benefits in picture and sound quality.

title: 567
subTitle: Animated Slide (8 effects)
scriptEn: Then what were the remaining conversations about?Recognition of AI performance does not necessarily mean that consumers fully understand AI TV.In the remaining conversations, many people still ask what AI TV is, why they need it and what value it can bring to their lives.Ultimately, consumers want to see meaningful experiences created by AI, rather than AI features alone.And there is another important signal to watch.Privacy currently accounts for only 4.5% of the conversation, but that does not mean it is unimportant.As AI evolves into a Life AI Agent that understands users' situations, remembers their preferences and acts proactively, consumers will naturally ask, "Can I trust this AI?"Privacy may represent a relatively small share of today's conversation, but as AI understands more personal context and takes more proactive action, these questions are likely to grow as well. LG intends to address trust not after expanding AI capabilities, but from the very beginning of designing the Agentic AI experience.

title: 567
subTitle: Animated Slide (4 effects)
scriptEn: This is precisely where the next opportunity for LG AI TV lies.In 2027, competition will be defined not by the number of AI features, but by who can be first to deliver an experience that feels truly agentic to consumers.LG aims to lead this transformation with a Trusted Life Agent that understands each customer’s context, communicates naturally, and proactively suggests the experiences they need.

title: Wi-fi Connected
subTitle: Animated Slide (55 effects)
scriptEn: First are Home Presence and Home Sound Alert.LG AI TV can detect whether the user is home or away based on whether the user’s mobile device is connected to the home Wi-Fi network.It can also adjust the volume automatically based on the viewing environment and situation, creating a more comfortable experience without requiring the user to change the settings manually.In addition, the TV can detect sounds such as a baby crying, a dog barking, a doorbell, or a fire or carbon monoxide alarm, and notify the user on screen.LG AI TV senses what's happening around the user, understands the context, and takes the appropriate action.

title: 1–7 Days After
subTitle: Animated Slide (21 effects)
scriptEn: Next is Proactive AI Recommendation.LG AI TV does not simply wait for the user to make a request.Based on TV usage history and content context, it proactively suggests content and features that may interest the user at the right moment. For example, if the user has not opened the LG Channels app for about a week after the initial setup of the TV, LG AI TV proactively introduces it.Likewise, if the user frequently watches content featuring a particular actor, the TV goes beyond displaying basic search results and naturally connects the user to related content.This is an example of understanding the user's preferences and intent, and then suggesting the next experience.

title: LG AI
subTitle: Animated Slide (21 effects)
scriptEn: The feature is Pin to Explore. When something in a scene sparks curiosity, users do not need to stop watching or reach for another device.By saying, "Search this scene," LG AI TV recognizes the context of the current screen and immediately explores and displays relevant information.LG AI TV goes beyond understanding a short command. It connects the command with the content and context of the scene currently being watched to deliver the desired result.As a result, search becomes a natural part of the content experience rather than a separate action that interrupts viewing.LG AI takes the right action.

title: Open Cast Menu
subTitle: Animated Slide (42 effects)
scriptEn: Interactive Cast is LG AI TV's new cross-device experience.LG's Interactive Cast goes one step further, enabling users to browse and control smartphone apps directly on the TV screen.For example, when an online shopping app is cast to the TV, users can view products in greater detail on the large screen while clicking, scrolling and browsing freely with the remote control.Because it uses the existing mobile app ecosystem without requiring a separate TV app installation, users can access a much wider range of services. Heavy processing is handled by the smartphone, enabling a smoother and more responsive experience on the TV.Ultimately, LG goes beyond simple screen sharing to offer a new cross-device experience in which the smartphone and TV work as one connected platform.

title: Recognize the situation
subTitle: Animated Slide (28 effects)
scriptEn: To summarize, customers generally expect Agentic AI to do three things.First, sense what is happening around them.Second, interpret the user's context and intent.Third, take the necessary action before the user has to complete every step themselves.

title: LG AI continuously observes andunderstands your environment
subTitle: Animated Slide (25 effects)
scriptEn: LG takes Agentic AI one step further.Our vision is a Trusted Life Agent through the Screen, one that understands customers, evolves with them, and continuously delivers value in everyday life.As AI develops into a Life AI Agent that senses the user’s situation, understands preferences and context, and proactively recommends and takes action, trust becomes increasingly important.As we saw earlier, privacy currently represents 4.5% of the overall conversation. But as AI understands customers more deeply and takes on a greater role, the question, “Can I trust this AI?” will become even more important.LG AI TV does not compromise trust for convenience. Instead, it makes trust the foundation of every personalized and proactive AI experience.On this foundation, customers can enjoy a Delightful Life with more to discover and enjoy, an Effortless Life that delivers what they need with less effort, and a Well-cared Life in which they can use AI with confidence.

title: Providing trusted protection forpersonal data, privacy and
subTitle: Animated Slide (32 effects)
scriptEn: LG AI TV’s Trusted Life Agent is more than a concept.To help customers use AI with confidence, enjoy powerful personalization, and continue to gain value over time, LG AI is built on three foundations.The first is Secured AI.LG Shield protects personal data, privacy, and AI interactions, allowing customers to use AI with confidence even as LG AI understands their context and provides personalized assistance.The second is Powerful Performance.The Alpha AI Processor intelligently understands the user, the viewing environment, and the content, translating that understanding into personalized picture, sound, and lifestyle experiences.The third is Lasting Value.Through continuous platform, AI, and service updates to webOS, the LG AI experience continues to evolve beyond the moment of purchase. As a result, the relationship between the customer and the TV becomes richer and more valuable over time.Ultimately, the strength of a Life AI Agent is not determined only by how much it knows or what it can do. It also depends on how securely it protects customer information, how reliably it delivers personalized experiences, and how continuously it enhances that value.

title: World’s First & Only Ultra Density Micro RGB Technology
subTitle: Animated Slide (30 effects)
scriptEn: Light naturally spreads. When conventional systems use a single light source for each of red, green and blue, each color spreads and affects the colors around it.For example, if there is a single red dot on a white flag, red light will spread around that dot.With its proprietary Ultra Density Micro RGB Technology, however, the 2027 LG Micro RGB evo arranges and controls RGB light sources with extreme density and precision, fundamentally eliminating color interference.LG has filed patent applications for this proprietary technology. To protect our intellectual property, we cannot disclose the specific technical details at this time. However, this light-source innovation has enabled the display to become the world's first certified Color Crosstalk Free display.
